description_en: Queries the details of all compliance pack templates provided by CloudConfig
description_zh: 查询配置审计提供的所有合规包模板及其详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun config list-compliance-pack-templates --compliance-pack-template-id ct-5f26ff4e06a300c40000 --rule-risk-level 2 --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --resource-types ACS::ECS::Instance --filter-type LAW --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCompliancePackTemplates

parameters.help_en: The ID of the compliance pack template
parameters.name: compliance_pack_template_id

parameters.help_en:
The risk level of the rules in the compliance pack. Valid values:

1: high
2: medium
3: low
parameters.help_zh:
合规包中规则模板的风险等级。取值：
1：高风险。
2：中风险。
3：低风险
parameters.name: rule_risk_level

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页时每页显示的数据行数。

取值范围：1~100。起始值：1。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number.

Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码。

起始值：1。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The resource type that is evaluated by the rules. If you specify this parameter, only the compliance pack templates that contain rules for the specified resource type are returned
parameters.help_zh: 规则评估的资源类型。输入该参数时，只返回合规包模板中包括该资源类型的规则
parameters.name: resource_types

parameters.help_en: The field used to filter the query results
parameters.name: filter_type

CompliancePackTemplatesResult.description_en: The details of the compliance pack templates

CompliancePackTemplates.description_en: A list of compliance pack templates

CompliancePackTemplateId.description_en: The ID of the compliance pack template

CompliancePackTemplateName.description_en: The name of the compliance pack template

ConfigRules.description_en: A list of default rules in the compliance pack
ConfigRules.description_zh: 合规包中默认规则列表

ConfigRuleParameters.description_en: The parameters of the managed rule

ParameterName.description_en: The name of the parameter for the managed rule

ParameterValue.description_en: The value of the parameter for the managed rule

Required.description_en:
Indicates whether the parameter is required for the managed rule. Valid values:

true: The parameter is required.
false: The parameter is not required
Required.description_zh:
规则模板中参数是否必填。取值：

true：参数必填。

false：参数非必填

ControlDescription.description_en: The description of the control. This parameter is returned only for compliance packs that are created based on a regulation
ControlDescription.description_zh: 法规类条目原文描述，只有法规类合规包包含此信息
ControlDescription.example: e) Possible known vulnerabilities should be found and remedied in a timely manner after adequate testing and evaluation.\nf) It shall be able to detect intrusion into important nodes and provide an alarm in case of serious intrusion events.

ControlId.description_en:
The ID of the control.

This parameter appears only for regulatory compliance packages
ControlId.description_zh:
法规条例ID。

仅法规类合规包显示该参数

DefaultEnable.description_en:
Indicates whether the rule can be quickly enabled. Valid values:

true: The rule can be quickly enabled.
false: The rule cannot be quickly enabled
DefaultEnable.description_zh:
规则是否支持快速启用。取值：
true：支持。
false：不支持

Description.example: If no vulnerabilities that are of the specified type and severity level and to be fixed exist on the running ECS instances that are protected by Security Center, the configuration is considered compliant. This rule does not apply to ECS instances that are not in the running state.

ManagedRuleIdentifier.description_en: The identifier of the managed rule

ManagedRuleName.description_en: The name of the managed rule

ResourceTypesScope.description_en: The resource types that are evaluated by the rule

RiskLevel.description_en:
The risk level of the managed rule. Valid values:

1: high
2: medium
3: low
RiskLevel.description_zh:
规则模板的风险等级。取值：
1：高风险。
2：中风险。
3：低风险

Description.description_en: The description of the compliance pack
Description.example: Checks the compliance of Alibaba Cloud resources based on the specific requirements of MLPS 2.0 Level 3.

Labels.description_en: The classification labels of the compliance pack

LastUpdate.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the compliance pack was last updated
LastUpdate.description_zh: 合规包最后更新的时间戳

RiskLevel.description_en:
The risk level of the rules in the compliance pack. Valid values:

1: high
2: medium
3: low
RiskLevel.description_zh:
合规包中规则模板的风险等级。取值：
1：高风险。
2：中风险。
3：低风险

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页时每页显示的数据行数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of compliance pack templates
